    // Optional parameters cannot also have initializer expressions, these are all errors
    
    function foo(x?: number = 1) { }

!!! error TS1015: Parameter cannot have question mark and initializer.

    var f2 = (x: number, y? = 1) => { }
    
    foo(1);
    foo();
    f(1);
    f();
    f2(1);
    f2(1, 2);
    
    class C {

    c.foo();
    c.foo(1);
